notes: Phase 3 ABI hard cutover: host Lib/Lib.Plugins assembly identities are UniversalDeviceToolkit.Lib / UniversalDeviceToolkit.Lib.Plugins. The artifacts.wpf filename is a historical alias from the retired WPF host ZIP; shipping UI is Electron + UniversalDeviceToolkit.Host. Keep this 5.0.2 baseline until the first v6.0.0-preview.1 application ZIP is published, then refresh. Official 2.x plugins declare minHostVersion 6.0.0 so a 5.x Host will refuse them at runtime. Serilog is a transitive dependency of UniversalDeviceToolkit.Lib and must be vendored alongside the host binaries.
